name: Neon MCP server
summary: Neon's hosted MCP server at mcp.neon.tech/mcp exposes the Neon management API and SQL on its Postgres service to an agent holding an OAuth grant or an API key: 119 tools in thirteen categories, listed with schemas by the vendor's keyless list-tools endpoint. Keyless on 2026-10-19 the plain path answered 401 with an RFC 9728 challenge; the docs category on the same path (?category=docs) answered initialize, tools/list (three tools) and a tools/call returning a documentation page with no credential. The SSE path the vendor dated for retirement answered 401, not 410.

vendor.name: Databricks, Inc., the parent company of Neon, LLC

license: MIT (repository); hosted under the Neon schedule

agentAccess.notes: Keyless 2026-10-19: initialize to mcp.neon.tech/mcp answered 401 invalid_token with a resource_metadata challenge; the vendor documents OAuth or an API key in the Authorization header. The docs category (?category=docs) answered keyless (200): three documentation tools, one exercised.

payments.notes: 2026-10-19: no keyless 402, no machine-payment protocol. Free plan $0/month; paid plans pay-as-you-go, metered hourly, billed monthly; the terms say fees are charged to the payment card on record and the billing page says charges are applied to the card on the first of the month.

jobs.summary: The vendor's tool table, docs category: 'Look up Neon documentation from within your assistant (no OAuth required)'. Measured keyless 2026-10-19: tools/list on ?category=docs listed list_docs_resources, get_doc_resource, send_feedback; one get_doc_resource call returned the vendor's MCP page.
